questions.question: How much did the furnished flat cost each week?

evidence.quote: A furnished flat at $8 per week.

questions.question: Who owned Jim's gold watch before him?

evidence.quote: One was Jim’s gold watch that had been his father’s and his grandfather’s.

questions.question: How far did Della's hair reach before she sold it?

evidence.quote: It reached below her knee and made itself almost a garment for her.

questions.question: How much did the chain cost and how much money did Della bring home?

evidence.quote: Twenty-one dollars they took
from her for it, and she hurried home with the 87 cents.

questions.question: At what time was the coffee made and the frying-pan ready for the chops?

evidence.quote: At 7 o’clock the coffee was made and the frying-pan was on the back of the stove hot and ready to cook the chops.

questions.question: How old was Jim?

evidence.quote: Poor fellow, he was only twenty-two

questions.question: What gift did Jim buy for Della?

evidence.quote: For there lay The Combs—the set of combs, side and back

questions.question: How did Jim get the money to buy Della's combs?

evidence.quote: I sold the watch to get the money to buy your combs.

questions.question: Compare what Della and Jim each sold to buy the other's gift.

evidence.quote: I had my hair cut off and sold it
I sold the watch to get the money to buy your combs.

questions.question: Why could neither Della nor Jim immediately use the gifts?

evidence.quote: the tresses that should have adorned the coveted adornments were gone.
I sold the watch to get the money to buy your combs.

books.title: Narrative of the Life of Frederick Douglass

questions.question: Where was Frederick Douglass born?

evidence.quote: I WAS born in Tuckahoe, near Hillsborough

questions.question: What was Douglass's mother's name?

evidence.quote: My mother was named Harriet Bailey.

questions.question: What does Douglass say about his mother's name and his father's race?

evidence.quote: My mother was named Harriet Bailey.
My father was a white man.

questions.question: What were the names of the master's two sons and daughter?

evidence.quote: two sons, Andrew and Richard; one daughter, Lucretia

questions.question: How many men worked in Colonel Lloyd's garden besides the chief gardener?

evidence.quote: almost constant employment for four men, besides the chief gardener

questions.question: Who succeeded Mr. Hopkins as overseer?

evidence.quote: Mr. Hopkins was succeeded by Mr. Austin Gore

questions.question: What was Douglass's new mistress's trade before she married?

evidence.quote: She was by trade a weaver

questions.question: How long did Douglass live in Master Hugh's family?

evidence.quote: I LIVED in Master Hugh’s family about seven years.

questions.question: When did Douglass leave Baltimore to live with Thomas Auld at St. Michael's?

evidence.quote: I left Baltimore, and went to live with Master Thomas Auld, at St. Michael’s, in March, 1832.

questions.question: When did Douglass go to live with Mr. Covey?

evidence.quote: went to live with Mr. Covey, on the 1st of January, 1833.
